method: Original AI-generated transparent PNG ornaments; no external references. Generated bytes, alpha and provenance retained unchanged.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent PNG cutout ornament for a digital bookshelf on a Bigme color e-ink reader, displayed at roughly 100-220 pixels tall. Subject: a beautiful miniature Japanese black pine bonsai, an asymmetrical wind-shaped trunk with three or four broad deep-green foliage pads, warm brown bark, a little moss, planted in a shallow blue-green glazed ceramic oval pot with short feet. Style: tactile, carefully crafted miniature, softly painterly realistic 3D object, like a collectible on a wooden bookshelf; not an icon, not a flat logo, not anime. Composition: one complete isolated object, straight-on with camera slightly above (about 12 degrees), subtle top surfaces visible, no dramatic perspective. Rich but restrained botanical greens, jade ceramic, brown bark; clear dark contours and broad color/value areas that remain legible on color e-ink, minimal fussy detail. Soft upper-left lighting with shading on the object only. Genuine transparent alpha background with no backdrop, floor, shelf, ground shadow, white rectangle or checkerboard drawing. Tightly framed in a square image, object fills about 90% of the height and width, entire pot and foliage visible, pot base near the bottom with only a small transparent margin. No text, label, watermark, border, additional objects or cropped branches. Deliver only this single ornament.
